answer: One concrete mechanism: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because trellis only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, delta is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any canyon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
